svg.title: Sheet 02: core log and commit load, Noah Schaufelberger
svg.desc: A technical drawing in single-stroke lettering. View C, a core log: two borings through the same 1,164 tracked hours on one linear scale, B-1 cut by language (Java 57.9 %, Markdown 16.0 %), B-2 by editor (IntelliJ IDEA 66.6 %, Claude Code 24.9 %), with a strata table. View D, a commit load diagram: the share of commits in each hour of the day over the 12 months to Sep 2026, busiest at 22:00. AI coding, all tools, 29.6 %, 2 h 38 min per coding day, Linux 58 % · Windows 42 %, logged since 2023-10-23. Dated 2026-09-26.
